items.title: Ricard Alexis Interview, 1959-01-16
items.q: I think he used to play with Sam Offen, the family.

ctx.x: Well, they went to school in Basin, Lewis, right with us, side by side. Johnny and Baby. My father knows that father and mother are all just like that. My brother of all, his brother would die at the drummer I tell you about. I think he used to play with Sam Offen, the family. He was running around Johnny's age, see. I'm running with Baby. We went to school together, all of us, in Basin, Lewis. And Lorenzo Teo, too, he went to school with us in Basin, Lewis. Really? The whole family had their home over there in…
The Teos. Lorenzo Teo. Over in there.
